about_short_description.short_description: Peakflo provides AI-powered software to automate accounts payable, accounts receivable, payments, and finance workflows.

product.name: Accounts Payable Automation
product.description: Software that automates invoice capture, approval workflows, purchase order matching, and bill payments to streamline accounts payable processes.

product.name: Accounts Receivable Automation
product.description: Platform to automate invoice issuance, payment reminders, collections workflows, and customer communication to improve receivables management.

product.name: AI Voice Agents
product.description: AI-powered voice agents that automate high-volume calls for sales outreach, collections, customer service, and delivery updates.

product.name: Travel & Expense Management
product.description: Software to manage travel requests, expense reporting, policy enforcement, approvals, and reimbursements with AI-powered expense capture.

product.name: End-to-End Payment Automation
product.description: Solution to automate collections, vendor payouts, fund splitting, and payment reconciliation for marketplaces and businesses.

product.name: Procurement Software
product.description: Digital system to create, approve, and manage purchase requests, quotes, orders, and vendor communications with automated workflows.
